title: The Massive Protostellar Cluster NGC 6334I at 220 au Resolution: Discovery of Further Multiplicity, Diversity, and a Hot Multi-core
question: What is the multiplicity, nature and SED of the sources in the massive protocluster NGC6334I at ~220 AU resolution from 5 cm to 1.3 mm?

data.bands: ALMA 3 mm and 1.3 mm (Cycle 2); VLA 5 cm, 1.5 cm, 7 mm

what.value: SMA 1.3 mm total integrated intensity 10.7±0.1 Jy at 1.6'' resolution

evidence.quote: The total 1.3 mm integrated intensity reported by (cite: Hunter06) for NGC6334I using $1.6''$ resolution SMA data is $10.7\pm 0.1$ Jy.

recipe.method: Line-free continuum imaging with MTMFS and multiscale clean, self-cal, primary-beam correction
Linear spectral index S∝ν^α from 3 and 1.3 mm images, 1.3 mm convolved to 3 mm beam
Multi-step 2D Gaussian decomposition of MM1 (7 components), MM2 core/halo, MM4A/MM6, subtracting components iteratively
key_parameters: extra 10% (Band 6) and 30% (Band 3) uncertainty added in quadrature for confused sources
assumptions: MM1B 1.3 mm flux extrapolated from 7 mm with spectral index 3.05

recipe.method: Free-free model V of Olnon75 (fit r_e) plus modified greybody dust fits with fixed beta=1.7; uncertainties from 1000 Monte Carlo realizations
key_parameters: Te=1e4 K; ne = 3e5, 3e6, 3e7 cm-3 for MM1D, MM1B, CM1

recipe.method: Dust mass equation with opacity correction; brightness temperature in Rayleigh-Jeans limit; Stefan-Boltzmann luminosities
assumptions: D=1.3 kpc, R=100, kappa_1.3mm=1 cm2/g (Ossenkopf & Henning 1994), spherical geometry

evidence.quote: The ALMA 1.3 mm data with a resolution of $\sim 0.17''$ actually recover more flux, 13.2 Jy, an increase of $23\%$.
The SED of MM2B exhibits a 7 mm-1.3 mm spectral index of $1.63\pm0.44$
MM1 shows considerable variation and structure in $\alpha_{mm}$, varying from 2.6-3.4
The close proximity of MM1B and MM1D (440 AU)
The fit shown in Fig. [6](#seds1) uses $\beta=2.4$

not_stated_but_needed: Line-free channel ranges and threshold per spw
Image sizes, clean thresholds and masks
Greybody fit code and frequency/flux inputs details
Initial guesses for Gaussian fits and fitting software
Details of the rms measurement regions
missing_for_reproduction: Gaussian fit initial guesses and code
score_reason: ALMA project code and most settings given, but fitting details and channel selections missing.
rediscovery_reason: Data are archival, recipe is mostly described, results (fluxes, sizes, Tb) are numeric.
